name: @local/dsh-agent-browser
description: Controlled browser panel for the DSH desktop app: the agent can read pages, fill inputs, take screenshots, and explicitly click controls (click:true; no Enter, no form.submit()). Password/file fields are never filled, and reading exposes only their value length.
author: Pazburg

scripts.test: node selftest.mjs && node client-selftest.mjs && node guest-dom-selftest.mjs
